env_context_strategy.evidence_quote: Autopilot: agent autonomously discovers endpoints, runs scans, and triages findings
env_context_strategy.note: Multi-valued list given though dimension is single-valued? Coded as agent-driven exploration via tools; also --knowledge-base/--prior-context can front-load context.

observation_format.evidence_quote: turn-based loop, built-in tool registry, skills support, and pluggable provider drivers
observation_format.note: Browser spidering is a native scan phase, not an agent observation modality.

loop_primitives.evidence_quote: Master agent analyzes inputs, selects modules, generates custom JS extensions, runs code audit and SAST, executes scans, and triages results
loop_primitives.note: Default agent modes: autopilot (turn-based loop, plans then scans then triage-rescan iterations).

planning_granularity.evidence_quote: agent autonomously plans attacks, selects modules, generates custom extensions, and triages results
planning_granularity.note: --plan-file allows a user-supplied plan; no evidence of a harness-stored plan object.

multi_agent_topology.evidence_quote: Swarm: master agent selects modules, generates custom JS attack extensions, runs code audit + SAST, executes scans, and triages results
multi_agent_topology.note: Autopilot also has an 'optional multi-specialist pipeline'; single-agent olium mode also shipped.

delegation_mechanism.evidence_quote: with optional multi-specialist pipeline and session resume
delegation_mechanism.note: Inferred from swarm sub-runs: 'swarm sub-runs' referenced in docs/coding-agent.md.

human_in_loop.evidence_quote: agent mode runs with no sandbox (the LLM has full shell, file, and network access on the host)
human_in_loop.note: Audit driver has an opt-in -i/--interactive mode; no per-action approval documented.

long_term_memory.evidence_quote: turn-based loop, built-in tool registry, skills support, and pluggable provider drivers

state_persistence.evidence_quote: --resume Resume a durable-autopilot run by agentic-scan UUID

self_verification.evidence_quote: master agent selects modules, generates custom JS attack extensions, runs code audit + SAST, executes scans, and triages results
self_verification.note: Triage/verify stages (autopilot_triage.go, autopilot_verify.go) act as model-based verification; scanner module re-runs confirm findings.

retry_policy.note: Triage-rescan loop capped by --max-iterations; closest value, could also read as fixed_n.

termination_condition.evidence_quote:
--max-commands Cap on agent tool calls
--token-budget Cap on aggregate tokens
--max-duration Max agent wall-clock time (0 = no limit)
termination_condition.note: Also a wall-clock --max-duration (no matching value); caps default to off/unlimited.

cost_controls.note: Prompt context cache file pkg/agent/prompt/context_cache.go exists but its behaviour is not documented.

timeouts.evidence_quote: --max-duration Max agent wall-clock time (0 = no limit)
timeouts.note: per_tool from JS execution `--timeout Execution timeout (default: 30s)` and HTTP `--timeout` (15s); per_run default is 0 = no limit.

execution_isolation.evidence_quote: agent mode runs with no sandbox (the LLM has full shell, file, and network access on the host)
execution_isolation.note: In-process Go olium runtime on the host; docs advise running in a disposable container/VM manually.

filesystem_access.evidence_quote: the LLM has full shell, file, and network access on the host

network_policy.evidence_quote: the LLM has full shell, file, and network access on the host
network_policy.note: Scope rules (`vigolium scope`) constrain scanning targets but not agent egress.

permission_model.evidence_quote: agent mode runs with no sandbox
permission_model.note: pkg/agent/guardrail.go exists but its enforcement is not documented in the evidence.

tracing.evidence_quote: --transcript Copy transcript.jsonl out after the run
tracing.note: Also session artifacts and runtime.log via /api/agent/sessions/:id/logs; Prometheus /metrics for the server.

replayability.evidence_quote: vigolium agent session Browse/replay agent session artifacts

eval_hooks.evidence_quote: Run benchmarks with `make test-canary` (Docker apps) or `make test-integration` (XSS).

guardrails.evidence_quote: Master agent analyzes inputs, selects modules, generates custom JS attack extensions
guardrails.note: Inferred from shipped pkg/agent/guardrail.go and pkg/agent/extension_validate.go (generated extensions are validated/linted before execution); no sandbox otherwise.

target_domain.evidence_quote: High-fidelity vulnerability scanner fusing agentic AI with native speed, modularity, and precision
target_domain.note: Primary domain is offensive security / vulnerability scanning ('other'); source-code audit gives swe, HTTP/browser target testing gives web.
